review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. WDFW/ODFW and NOAA/California habitat sources support shallow rocky/kelp habitat; no numeric preferred SST evidence found.

profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for kelp greenling.
factors.value_notes: WDFW, ODFW and IUCN sources document kelp/rock habitat and geographic range but do not establish a numeric preferred SST or adult thermal-response curve. The configured 8-16 °C range and 10-14 °C ideal remain unsupported by species-specific temperature evidence; keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for kelp greenling.
factors.value_notes: WDFW reports rocky inshore habitat and kelp beds to about 46 m; ODFW reports to 25 fathoms, and the IUCN account describes intertidal/subtidal rocky reefs, kelp and eelgrass typically to 50 m. A Farallon Islands survey records a broader 0-100 m range. This supports shallow demersal habitat, but the configured 1-40 m / 3-35 m interval is not a universal preference across regions.

text.day: Full daylight when Pacific gamefish actively hunt.

timing.note: West Coast captain reports and biological upwelling patterns.
